apps/api/src/lib/jwt.js.description: JSON Web Token utility for authentication. Manages generation and verification of access (15m) and refresh (7d) tokens, and handles httpOnly cookie management with secure/sameSite defaults.

apps/api/src/lib/mentions.js.description: Regex-based extractor for user @mentions. Supports both sanitized HTML spans (TipTap format) and markdown tokens (used in comments and goals).

apps/api/src/lib/notifications.js.description: Core notification dispatcher. Persists notification rows and pushes real-time alerts to specific users via Socket.io. Also triggers email alerts for mentions.

apps/api/src/lib/prisma.js.description: PrismaClient singleton. Ensures a single connection pool is shared across the entire API to prevent connection exhaustion during development reloads.

apps/api/src/lib/sanitize.js.description: HTML sanitization wrapper using sanitize-html. Configured for TipTap content, allowing specific tags (span, a, p) and attributes while forcing external links to safe targets.

apps/api/src/lib/socket.js.description: Socket.io implementation for real-time features. Manages workspace rooms, user-specific rooms, and presence tracking (Map-based). Handles JWT authentication via handshake cookies.

apps/api/src/middleware/auth.js.description: Authentication middleware. Verifies the 'accessToken' httpOnly cookie and attaches the userId to 'req.user'.

apps/api/src/middleware/permission.js.description: Capability-based authorization middleware. Checks if 'req.member' (attached by workspace middleware) has the required capability from @team-hub/shared.

apps/api/src/middleware/workspace.js.description: Workspace isolation middleware. Validates that the user is a member of the requested workspace and attaches the membership row (including role) to 'req.member'.

apps/api/src/routes/actionItems.js.description: Route definitions for Action Items. Scoped to a workspace and protected by capability-based permissions.

apps/api/src/routes/announcements.js.description: Route definitions for Announcements. Includes nested routers for comments and reactions.

apps/api/src/routes/auth.js.description: Route definitions for Authentication. Handles registration (including default workspace creation), login, logout, refresh, and profile management (including avatar uploads).

apps/api/src/routes/goals.js.description: Route definitions for Goals. Scoped to workspace, supports status updates and activity history. Nests milestones.

apps/api/src/routes/invitations.js.description: Public route definitions for Invitation acceptance. Allows public preview of invitation details via token.

apps/api/src/routes/invitations.workspac.description: Admin-only route definitions for managing workspace invitations (create, list, revoke, resend).

apps/api/src/routes/notifications.js.description: Route definitions for User notifications. Supports marking single or all as read.

apps/api/src/routes/workspaces.js.description: Route definitions for Workspace management. Includes presence, analytics, exports, and audit log routes. Nests members and admin invitations.

apps/api/src/templates/email/invitation..description: Email template for Workspace invitations. Generates HTML and plain-text versions with workspace accent colors.

apps/api/src/templates/email/mention.js.description: Email template for @mentions. Generates simple notification alerts with deep links to the relevant content.

apps/web/.env.example.description: Example environment variables for the frontend. Includes API and Socket URLs.

apps/web/jsconfig.json.description: Javascript configuration for Next.js. Defines the '@/*' path alias mapping to 'src/*'.

apps/web/next.config.js.description: Next.js configuration. Enables PWA support, configures Cloudinary image domains, and injects environment variables.

apps/web/package.json.description: Frontend package manifest. Lists dependencies for Next.js 16, React 19, TipTap, Dnd-kit, and Zustand.
